items.name: Facial verification and liveness
items.description: Our technology detects a live person (liveness) with iBeta Level 2 certification, confirming the person in front of the camera is who they claim to be and is present in the moment, preventing fraud with photos, videos, or masks.

items.name: Advanced electronic signature
items.description: Sign documents with full legal validity. The signer's biometric identity is bound to the document, guaranteeing non-repudiation and full traceability.

items.name: Digital onboarding (KYC)
items.description: Automate capture of identity document data (OCR) and verify it against official databases. Cut customer onboarding from days to seconds.

items.name: Biometric attendance
items.description: Let employees clock in from their phones with facial validation and geolocation. Ideal for remote and field work.

items.name: Flexible REST API
items.description: Integrate all of these capabilities into your own ERP, CRM, or mobile apps with our documented API and lightweight SDKs.

seguridadPage.metaDescription: Banking-grade security standards, iBeta certifications, and GDPR compliance.
seguridadPage.title: Security without compromise
seguridadPage.sub: We protect your data and your customers' data to the highest industry standards.

cards.title: Military-grade encryption
cards.body: All data is encrypted in transit (TLS 1.3) and at rest (AES-256). Your cryptographic keys are managed in an HSM.

cards.title: Passive liveness detection
cards.body: ISO 30107-3 certification (iBeta Level 2). Prevents presentation attacks such as 3D masks, videos, or high-resolution photos.

cards.title: Regulatory compliance
cards.body: We adhere to GDPR, CMF regulation (Chile), and ISO 27001 standards, ensuring privacy and ethical handling of data.
